Now, one more important consideration: the `bounded_containers` pre-scan counts ALL containers including those inside... it rejects if count > 300000. A valid request has ≤ 283,548 ✓.

Hmm, one important detail: `sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_BYTES+1)` — if the input is exactly 64MiB, read returns 64MiB ✓ (len == MAX_BYTES → passes). If larger, we read MAX_BYTES+1 → reject ✓.
